description: Ember (P5, Thunderberge, Æthertech ×4) with Catcher vs Rhodagn, which attacks the controlled operator (Ember) at 1 and 8 s (its clock: time stops delay them); Ember starts with her ultimate charged. The battle skill at 0.5 s is attacked inside its listener (frames 0–38): the slam deals 10 more Stagger (guard), talent 2 gives an ATK layer, and the attack opens her combo window; the combo Knocks Down again, heals the controlled operator (combo heal: Thunderberge's shield on her) and gives Protection with talent 1. The ultimate gives the team its shield and, at P5, ATK +10% to each holder for 10 s. The attack at 8 s lands at 9.93 s (the combo's slow-down and the ultimate's time stop delay it), inside the second battle skill's listener (cast at 9.8 s): a second guard and a new talent-2 layer.
